project_name: Arts of Finance - Lead & Admission Management System

theme_strategy.description: Clean, high-trust, executive financial training institute portal with crisp borders, deep slate headers, vibrant emerald/green accents for conversion & WhatsApp actions, and warm subtle gold highlights for offer countdowns.

scale.hero_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing system with strict card padding and clear visual hierarchy for fast Indian office staff usage.
spacing_and_layout.bento_strategy: High Density Grid for Admin KPI & Counsellor My Leads. Single column responsive mobile view with direct touch-friendly tap targets.

reception.goal: Fast single-page walk-in student entry (~5-6 visits/day). Big touch buttons, instant duplicate phone check warning, success screen with assigned counsellor details.

counsellor.goal: Immediate access to Today's Visits & Pending Follow-ups. Live 11:59 PM Offer Expiry Timer, big green 'Send on WhatsApp' click-to-chat action, payment link generator, quick note modal.

admin.goal: Complete overview of Revenue, Visits, Conversion rate per Counsellor, Permission Matrix editor, Fee structure editor, WhatsApp template management, back-ups & soft-delete restore.

key_components.name: Reception Visit Form
key_components.notes: Large touch inputs, auto counsellor round-robin badge, consent checkbox, duplicate phone warning badge, immediate submit confirmation card.

key_components.name: New Lead Alert Modal
key_components.notes: Pops up when lead assigned. Pre-filled WhatsApp message preview with instant wa.me action.

key_components.name: Counsellor Lead Card & Timer
key_components.notes: Displays course, status pill, same-day 10% discount countdown timer (expires 11:59 PM), fast WhatsApp button.

key_components.name: Lead Detail Page & Timeline
key_components.notes: Chronological audit log timeline (visits, notes, status changes, Razorpay payment status, receipts), template picker dropdown.

key_components.name: Admin Permission Matrix
key_components.notes: Toggle matrix grid (rows=roles/users, cols=permissions like lead_create, lead_delete, offer_override, view_analytics).

key_components.name: Template Editor with Chips
key_components.notes: Clickable dynamic chips like {student_name}, {course_name}, {offer_discount}, {counsellor_name} to insert into message body.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select dropdowns, modals, role switchers, action triggers) must have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Javascript (.jsx) React convention for all components inside /app/frontend/src/.
Implement clear role switching in header for testing (Admin, Counsellor, Receptionist) with active user state.
Use Shadcn UI components from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ for Dialog, Select, Dropdown, Tabs, Table, Badge, Input, Button, Card, Switch, Tooltip, Sonner toasts.
Ensure 10% offer logic displays countdown timer expiring at 11:59 PM today on visit creation day.
Simulate Razorpay test mode link generator and 45-second polling status update for instant receipt preview.
Ensure exact duplicate phone detection flags prior lead record before saving visit.
Ensure all buttons have hover states, aria labels, and data-testid attributes.
